build_spectral_conv: build a spectral normalized Conv2d layer using spectral_conv_function with specified channels and kernel size
build_plain_conv: build a standard Conv2d layer using conv_function with specified input output channels and kernel size
get_conv_layer_from_opt: get the appropriate convolution layer function based on whether spectral normalization is enabled in opt
create_resnet_block: create a ResNet_Block with optional downsampling or upsampling using the ResNet_Block class
create_identity_module: create an Identity passthrough nn.Module that returns its input unchanged using the Identity class
